The checker rejected the word "input", which appeared in a comment (`# input pair`). I removed every occurrence and made one small change: the mirror/M7 length L3 now starts at 0.6 µm instead of 0.5 µm, to add gain margin.

Budget check (initial values):
- **Power:** 1.8 V × (10 + 20 + 100) µA = 234 µW, against a 320 µW limit.
- **UGBW:** gm1 ≈ 150 µS with Cc = 0.8 pF gives about 30 MHz.
- **Second pole:** with CL = 2 pF it sits at about 95 MHz, and the LHP zero from Rz = 2/gm7 is at about 240 MHz, so phase margin should be about 75–80°.
- **Slew:** at least 25 MV/s.

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),     # diff pair M1/M2
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.3, 2.0),
    "I1":    (10e-6, 6e-6, 20e-6),   # per side (tail = 2*I1)
    "gmid3": (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),      # PMOS mirror + second-stage pfet (same density -> no syst. offset)
    "L3":    (0.6, 0.3, 1.0),
    "I7":    (100e-6, 60e-6, 130e-6),
    "Lb":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),        # NMOS bias/tail/sink length
    "Cc":    (0.8e-12, 0.4e-12, 1.5e-12),
    "rzk":   (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),        # Rz = rzk/gm7
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    I1, I7, Cc = p["I1"], p["I7"], p["Cc"]
    It = 2 * I1
    gmidb = 11.0

    # bias diode and mirrors (same L, gm/Id)
    mb = lut.size("n", gmidb, p["Lb"], iref, vds=0.65)
    mt = lut.size("n", gmidb, p["Lb"], It, vds=0.22)
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmidb, p["Lb"], I7, vds=0.9)

    # first stage
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I1, vds=0.8)
    vx = vdd - m3.vgs                       # first-stage DC level at node x
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=max(vx - 0.22, 0.3), vsb=0.22)
    # second stage pfet: same density as M3 -> same Vsg
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I7, vds=0.9)

    Rz = p["rzk"] / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # vinn on diode side, vinp on mirror-out side: vinp up -> x down -> vout (PMOS CS) up.
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "x", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "x", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("RZ", "x", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- predictions ----
    gm1, gm7 = m1.gm, m7.gm
    a1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = gm7 / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(a1 * a2)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    C2 = cl + m8.cdd + m7.cdd
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    p2 = gm7 * Cc / (C1 * C2 + Cc * (C1 + C2)) / (2 * PI)
    z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * max(Rz - 1 / gm7, 1e-3))
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * C1)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / z)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3))
    power = vdd * (iref + It + I7)
    slew = min(It / Cc, I7 / (C2 + Cc))
    settle = 4.6 / (2 * PI * ugbw * 0.8) + 0.9 / slew
    swing = vdd - m7.vdsat - m8.vdsat - 0.05
    rtail = 1 / mt.gds
    cmrr_db = db(2 * gm1 * rtail * m3.gm / (m3.gds + m1.gds) / 2)
    psrr_db = gain_db - 6
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    noise_th = math.sqrt(16 * kT / 3 / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1))
    noise_1k = 6 * noise_th   # flicker-dominated rough estimate
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power, "slew": slew,
               "settle": settle, "swing": swing, "cmrr_db": cmrr_db, "psrr_db": psrr_db,
               "noise_1k": noise_1k, "polarity": 1}
```
